description: Stone-caller - shapes the earth into a rising stack of momentum and spends it on one target.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from data/reference/coa/primalist.json (39 real CoA Geomancy talents, role DPS, 'Elemental Shaman single-target build'). Replaces a 23-node tree of 18 pure scalars and 1 proc. The big structural change: Earthshaping, which CoA makes a level 10 passive and which every other talent here reads, was the tier 6 capstone and is now tier 0. All 4 unlock nodes are preserved - see tools/qa_abilities_obtainable.py for why that is not optional.

nodes.name: Earthshaping
nodes.description: Geode Barrage and your Seismic spells shape the earth around you, increasing your haste by 1% for 6 turns, stacking 15 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 10 Passive. Casting Geode Barrage and your Seismic abilities now generate Earthshaping. Earthshaping: Empowers some of your abilities and increases your spell haste by 1% for 20 seconds, stacking 15 times.' MOVED FROM TIER 6 TO TIER 0. It is a level 10 passive in CoA and every other talent in this tree reads it; as the capstone you could take all of them before you could take this. The old node generated off Geode Barrage and Quake at 5 stacks of 3%; CoA's generator list is Geode Barrage plus the Seismic abilities, and CoA's ramp is 15 stacks of 1% - same +15% ceiling, longer climb. 20 sec is 6 turns.

nodes.name: Stoneskin
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by up to 200% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your Armor by 200% of your Intellect.' Split across CoA's 2 ranks, so a full investment is the 200% CoA states. This conversion is live: 'armor' is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and 'intellect' in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES. Fraction, so 1.00 per rank. Was armor_pct 3.0.

nodes.name: Trembling Rage
nodes.description: Seismic Tremor generates 2 additional Rage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the amount of Rage generated by Seismic Tremor by 2.' Primalist is a dual-resource class (mana and Rage) and Terrasurge costs Rage while the Geomancy spells cost mana, so this is the bridge between the two halves of the kit.

nodes.name: Molten Fervor
nodes.description: Increases your haste by up to 5%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your spell haste by 5%.' A talent effect applies to its own character only - there is no party-aura mechanism - so the raid-wide half is dropped and the description says 'your' rather than promising the party a buff it will not get. Haste here means acting more often on the turn meter, not casting faster.

nodes.name: One With The Earth
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Stoneshard and Geode Barrage by 20%, and Stoneshard restores 4% of your maximum mana.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Stoneshard and Geode Barrage by 20% and Stoneshard now restores 4% of your maximum mana.' Both halves built. Was crit_chance_spell 1.0, which is neither half.

nodes.name: Blessing of Therazane
nodes.description: Shaping the earth also sharpens your aim, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 1% per stack.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each stack of Earthshaping now increases your critical damage dealt by 5%.' Nothing reads another effect's stack count, so this is built as a PARALLEL stacking buff on the same trigger - it climbs in lockstep with Earthshaping, which is what 'per stack of Earthshaping' means in practice. The stat is crit CHANCE, not CoA's crit DAMAGE, because crit_damage_spell is read through get_talent_effects() and that never includes status effects: a proc-applied crit-damage buff would be dead data. A status effect's stat_mods ARE multiplied by stacks, which is what makes the per-stack part real.

nodes.name: Primal Shaman's Mask
nodes.description: Your direct damage has a 10% chance to hurl a geode at the enemy, dealing extra damage and generating 5 Rage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Direct damage dealt now has a 10% chance to launch a Geode at the enemy. Geode: Hurl an enchanted stone at the target, dealing Physical Damage and generating 5 Rage.' There is no primalist_geode ability to cast_ability into, so the geode is priced as damage_flat on the same trigger. 120 is in line with Frontier's other flat proc damage at this depth. Rage amount is CoA's. Was ability_primalist_quake_damage +6%.

nodes.name: Magma Fissure
nodes.description: Learn Magma Fissure. Stomp the ground and send a wave of molten stone through the enemy line.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Stomp the ground and unleash a wave of earth and stone in a 20 yd line that knocks all enemies to the side and deals Fire damage, piercing absorption effects. Your next spell within 6 seconds is instant cast.' The line, the knockback and the instant-cast rider are all gone - no positioning, no cast times. Kept from the previous tree.

nodes.name: Everlasting Rage
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Seismic Tremor by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Seismic Tremor by 5 sec and its tick rate by -10%.' 5 sec is under 2 turns, rounded up to 2 since 1 would be a smaller buff than CoA's. The tick-rate half is dropped: ticks are per-turn here, so there is no sub-turn rate to speed up.

nodes.name: Cataclysm
nodes.description: Casting Stoneshard has a 10% chance to make your Seismic spells ready again at once.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Generating Earthshaping or casting Stoneshard now has a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of your Seismic abilities.' Only the Stoneshard half is built: 'generating Earthshaping' would mean a proc that fires off another proc's application, and no trigger expresses that. 10% is CoA's, with a 1-turn internal cooldown so it cannot chain. Omitting `turns` from reset_cooldown is a FULL reset, which is what CoA says.

nodes.name: Rockslide
nodes.description: Stoneshard has a 15% chance to cast a second time.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Stoneshard now has a 15% chance to cast an additional time. This effect can trigger itself.' cast_ability takes a bare ability id. The self-triggering part comes free: the re-cast is itself a damage cast, so it rolls again, which is exactly what CoA describes - no icd, deliberately.

nodes.name: Quake
nodes.description: Learn Quake. Shake the ground under a whole group of enemies.
nodes._source: Kept from the previous tree.

nodes.name: Volcanic Blast
nodes.description: Your critical strikes splash 10% of the damage onto up to 3 nearby enemies as Fire damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Physical or Nature damaging critical strikes now deal an additional 10% of the damage dealt as Fire damage to the target and enemies nearby.' splash_damage is the live payload for exactly this and takes a school, so the Fire conversion is real rather than cosmetic. The Physical-or-Nature restriction on the TRIGGER is dropped: on_crit cannot filter by the school of the crit, and Geomancy's damage is almost entirely those two schools anyway.

nodes.name: Therazane's Might
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Terrasurge by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Terrasurge will now always critically strike against targets affected by your Seismic Tremor.' The condition is what balances it and no effect key reads whether the target carries a specific DoT, so this is a large crit bonus rather than an unconditional ability_*_crit of 100.0 - which is what the literal reading would be and would be a permanent guaranteed crit on the spec's hardest hit. ability_*_crit is a PERCENT. Was ability_primalist_geode_barrage_damage +3%.

nodes.name: Stone Tosser
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by up to 25% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases spell bonus damage scaling of Geode Barrage, Stoneshard, and Seismic Crash by 25%.' There is no key for 'how much an ability scales with spell power' - the scaling coefficients live on the abilities themselves - so this is built as the spell power those abilities consume, which raises them all by the same mechanism. Also carries CoA's Crushing the Earth ('spell power equal to 50% of your armor penetration rating'), which is not buildable: armor_penetration is not in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, and an unknown pairing is skipped in silence.

nodes.name: Geomolding
nodes.description: Seismic Tremor's damage over time builds Geomolding, increasing your damage dealt by 3% per stack.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt by Seismic Tremor now grants Geomolding for 15 seconds. Geomolding: Your next Terrasurge costs 2 additional Rage and deals 3% increased damage. Stacks 20 times.' Two departures. It triggers on the CAST rather than on each periodic tick, because no periodic-tick trigger exists in this engine. And the bonus is general damage rather than Terrasurge-only, because ability_*_damage is read through get_talent_effects() and a status effect cannot reach it - damage_dealt_pct is the status-effect route, and it is percentage POINTS, so 3.0. CoA's Rage surcharge is dropped: cost keys are reduction-signed, so a surcharge must be written negative, which is indistinguishable from the sign error the audit now flags. CoA's 20 stacks kept.

nodes.name: Magmatism
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Magma Fissure by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Eruption by 15 sec and causes Magma Geodes to deal 30% more damage to enemies above 75% health.' Frontier has no Eruption ability, so that half is dropped, and Magma Geodes are routed to Magma Fissure, the Fire area spell we do have. The above-75%-health CONDITION is dropped too: there is no high-health damage key - low_health_healing_pct is the only recipient-health conditional in the engine and it is heal-side - and the first draft invented high_health_damage_threshold_pct, which the audit correctly called dead. Repriced 30% -> 20% because it now applies unconditionally.

nodes.name: Golem Form
nodes.description: Learn Golem Form. Become stone, slower to hurt and quicker to act.
nodes._source: CoA: '15% of base mana, 2 min cooldown. Transform into a being made of stone and earth for 20 sec, increasing your haste by 20% and your Armor by 50%, and allowing you to cast damaging spells while moving.' The casting-while-moving clause is meaningless here. Kept from the previous tree, where this unlock was confusingly named Cave Dweller.

nodes.name: Cave Dweller
nodes.description: Increases your maximum mana by up to 6%.
nodes._source: CoA has TWO talents named Cave Dweller. This is the second: 'Increases your maximum Rage by 15 and reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 50%.' Pushback does not exist - no cast bars - so that half is dropped. The FIRST Cave Dweller ('armor penetration rating equal to 50% of your Intellect') is not built at all: armor_penetration is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, so the pairing would be skipped in silence. The Rage half is not buildable either, which is why this node grants mana instead: max_rage is a hardcoded 100 in Character.__init__ and no code reads a talent bonus into it, so 'rage_max' was a dead key and 'increases your maximum Rage' is not something a talent can do here. Rerouted to mana headroom, which is live and serves the same purpose for a spec whose damage spells are all mana-costed.

nodes.name: Earth Pummeling
nodes.description: Geode Barrage makes the target 3% easier to critically hit with spells for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Geode Barrage and Geodes to increase the chance for the enemy to be critically hit with spells by 3% for 12 seconds.' There is no recipient-side 'chance to be crit' key - crit chance lives on the attacker - so this is built as spell damage taken, which is the live recipient-side key and delivers the same thing the talent is for: your spells hurt this target more. 12 sec is 4 turns.

nodes.name: Seismic Tremor
nodes.description: Learn Seismic Tremor. Send a tremor through the ground that builds as it travels.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up over time. Damage dealt generates 1 Rage. Generates 2 stacks of Earthshaping.' Kept from the previous tree. Three nodes here modify it (Trembling Rage, Everlasting Rage, Geomolding), which is an argument for moving it earlier - left at tier 5 because it is a capstone-adjacent ability in CoA too and the modifiers are all spread across tiers 0-3 where they can be banked first.

nodes.name: Therazane's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases the damage your damage-over-time effects deal by up to 10%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 50 Passive. Allows the periodic damage dealt by Seismic Tremor, Seismic Crash, and Earthquake to critically strike.' Whether DoT ticks can crit is an engine-wide rule, not a per-character bonus, so it is not a talent effect at all. Rebuilt as DoT damage, which is the same intent - make this spec's periodic damage matter - through a key that is live. dot_damage is unconditionally live, unlike the flavour-specific bleed_dot_damage, which resolves for no ability in the game.

nodes.name: Heavy Earth
nodes.description: Terrasurge spends the shaped earth, dealing 32.4% more damage and leaving you unable to shape more for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Terrasurge now consumes all stacks of Earthshaping to refresh the duration of Golem Form and grant you Heavy Earth. Each stack consumed grants 5% additional damage dealt with Stoneshard and Geode Barrage as Nature Damage while this is active. Lasts 8 sec. While active you cannot generate Earthshaping.' The consume-and-scale core is the thing this engine cannot do: consumes_stacks_of reads the caster's own stacks but only extends a DoT's duration, and Terrasurge is a direct damage ability. So the capstone pays out as a flat Terrasurge bonus plus a fixed window of extra damage, and the description says 'spends the shaped earth' rather than quoting a per-stack number it cannot honour. The 'cannot generate Earthshaping while active' lockout is also unbuildable - no payload suppresses another proc - and the description's 'unable to shape more' is kept as flavour that does not promise a number. Flagged rather than faked.
